title: Correction to c51's review of the dense sink escape: the sheet (100 t frames) cannot show rods leaving discs whole, and it shows the populations shrinking to 6, 8 and 2 bodies by t=1600; verdict and numbers otherwise unchanged
summary: Replaces 20261027T0413-c51-review-marangoni-sink-dense, whose limitation said the S sheet shows rods leaving discs whole: I had not looked at it then, and at 100 t per frame it cannot show that. Looking at it now (20261027T0413-c51-review-marangoni-sink-dense/S_s97/sheet.png), discs cover a large part of the box from t~280 on and the rods thin out: components at the end are 6 (S), 8 (I) and 2 (S at mar 0), from maxima of 21, 14 and 22. The escape counts from fate.py stand (21/35 at mar 40 vs 6/30 at mar 0, seed 97), as does the per-cycle distance in S (median D 2.33, n=6) against I (1.69, n=12); the translation clause remains unchecked by me, and at this disc rate the population is not sustained on this seed. This note carries no re-run of its own (the runs are in the parent review) and is not meant to count as a second review.

verdicts.limitation: Same run as 20261027T0413-c51-review-marangoni-sink-dense (seed 97); this corrects only its unsupported sheet statement and adds the end-of-run body counts. One disc per 50 t nearly empties the box on this seed, so the dense arm does not hold a population long enough to measure selection.
